items.reason: The PR starts search watching before initializing the broadcaster (pkg/storage/unified/resource/server.go:303-310; search.go:203-213). Each SQL WatchWriteEvents call starts from the latest database versions, so writes between those subscriptions are excluded from the broadcaster’s stream (pkg/storage/unified/sql/backend.go:558-567). A subsequent Watch requesting an earlier Since cannot recover those events: it only filters the broadcaster stream without fetching historical changes (pkg/storage/unified/resource/server.go:847-867).
